# PowerShell completion for rtok
# Generated by Pyrlyn.CommandLine.Docs from the command model; do not edit.

Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native -CommandName 'rtok' -ScriptBlock {
    param($wordToComplete, $commandAst, $cursorPosition)
    $children = @{
        '' = @('completions', 'config', 'hook', 'man', 'plugins')
        'config' = @('get', 'init', 'path', 'set', 'show', 'validate')
    }
    $options = @{
        '' = @('-h', '--help', '--version')
        'completions' = @('--install', '--uninstall', '-h', '--help', '--version')
        'config get' = @('--json', '--config', '-h', '--help', '--version')
        'config init' = @('--force', '--config', '-h', '--help', '--version')
        'config path' = @('--config', '-h', '--help', '--version')
        'config set' = @('--config', '-h', '--help', '--version')
        'config show' = @('--sources', '--json', '--config', '-h', '--help', '--version')
        'config validate' = @('--config', '-h', '--help', '--version')
        'hook' = @('--host', '--serve', '-h', '--help', '--version')
        'man' = @('--dir', '-h', '--help', '--version')
        'plugins' = @('--json', '-h', '--help', '--version')
    }
    $values = @(
        'config get|--config'
        'config init|--config'
        'config path|--config'
        'config set|--config'
        'config show|--config'
        'config validate|--config'
        'hook|--host'
        'man|--dir'
    )
    $hints = @{
        '|completions' = 'Print or install shell completions (bash, zsh, fish, powershell; clink for Windows cmd).'
        '|hook' = 'Run one hook event from stdin, or serve hooks as this home''s resident.'
        '|man' = 'Print the man page (roff), or write every page with --dir.'
        '|plugins' = 'List plugins: id, kind, enabled, surfaces.'
        '|-h' = 'Show help.'
        '|--help' = 'Show help.'
        '|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'completions|--install' = 'Write the script to the shell''s per-user completions directory.'
        'completions|--uninstall' = 'Remove what --install wrote.'
        'completions|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'completions|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'completions|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'config|get' = 'Print the effective value of one key or table.'
        'config|init' = 'Write the reference config file (every key commented out at its default) and print its path.'
        'config|path' = 'Print the path of the user config file.'
        'config|set' = 'Set a key in the user config file, keeping its comments; the result is checked first.'
        'config|show' = 'Print every effective key and value; secrets are redacted.'
        'config|validate' = 'Check a config file: unknown keys, types and ranges, with file:line; exit 1 on any problem.'
        'config get|--json' = 'Print JSON.'
        'config get|--config' = 'The config file to use instead of ~/.rtok/config.toml.'
        'config get|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'config get|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'config get|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'config init|--force' = 'Overwrite an existing file.'
        'config init|--config' = 'The config file to use instead of ~/.rtok/config.toml.'
        'config init|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'config init|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'config init|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'config path|--config' = 'The config file to use instead of ~/.rtok/config.toml.'
        'config path|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'config path|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'config path|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'config set|--config' = 'The config file to use instead of ~/.rtok/config.toml.'
        'config set|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'config set|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'config set|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'config show|--sources' = 'Show where each value came from: default, a file and line, env or flag.'
        'config show|--json' = 'Print JSON.'
        'config show|--config' = 'The config file to use instead of ~/.rtok/config.toml.'
        'config show|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'config show|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'config show|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'config validate|--config' = 'The config file to use instead of ~/.rtok/config.toml.'
        'config validate|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'config validate|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'config validate|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'hook|--host' = 'The host id, when the host is not inferred from the payload.'
        'hook|--serve' = 'Run the resident hook server that rtok-hook talks to.'
        'hook|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'hook|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'hook|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'man|--dir' = 'Write rtok.1 and a page for every subcommand into this directory, and print their paths.'
        'man|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'man|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'man|--version' = 'Show version.'
        'plugins|--json' = 'Print JSON.'
        'plugins|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'plugins|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'plugins|--version' = 'Show version.'
    }
    $cmd = ''
    $skip = $false
    foreach ($element in ($commandAst.CommandElements | Select-Object -Skip 1)) {
        if ($element.Extent.EndOffset -ge $cursorPosition) { break }
        $word = $element.ToString()
        if ($skip) {
            $skip = $false
        } elseif ($word.StartsWith('-')) {
            $skip = $values -contains "$cmd|$word"
        } elseif ($children[$cmd] -contains $word) {
            $cmd = "$cmd $word".Trim()
        }
    }
    if ($skip) { return }
    $list = if ($wordToComplete.StartsWith('-')) { $options[$cmd] } else { $children[$cmd] }
    foreach ($item in $list) {
        if ($item.StartsWith($wordToComplete, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)) {
            $hint = $hints["$cmd|$item"]
            if (-not $hint) { $hint = $item }
            [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($item, $item, 'ParameterValue', $hint)
        }
    }
}
